title: ReserveQueueJoined
description: A JOIN went to the reserve queue (CONTRACTS §6; GAMEPLAY GP-3, RQ-1; STATE-MACHINES §4.1): the cap is reached, the queue is not empty, or the campaign is paused (Q-ALN-26). Also emitted when a queued commander's new JOIN replaces its entry. Public view: queue length only.
